import pytest

from inventory import Inventory


def test_add_negative_quantity_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Inventory().add("apple", -1)


def test_remove_negative_quantity_rejected():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("apple", 2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        inv.remove("apple", -1)
    assert inv.quantity("apple") == 2
